dedupe_keys.name: a database of building surface carbon mitigation potential from solar radiation across different climate zones of china

description: Pingan Ni and colleagues publish a building-stock collection representing sixteen cities across five climate zones in China for assessing building-integrated photovoltaics. The deposited metadata describe building density, stock counts, climate classifications and six height classes separated at 12, 27, 54, 100 and 200 metres. Spatial morphology representations accompany the statistical indicators. A ZIP dataset and description document are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. These inputs can define urban building distributions and compare solar-resource assumptions in infrastructure simulations. The public summary identifies cities as C1–C16; their actual names, observation dates, coordinate reference system and internal file formats remain unknown without the documentation. No measured carbon savings or validated photovoltaic production should be inferred from the title. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. The data archive and description PDF were not downloaded.
